title: Data Privacy Principles
text: Data privacy refers to the appropriate handling, processing, and protection of personal information. Common principles across privacy frameworks worldwide include data minimization (collecting only what is necessary), purpose limitation (using data only for stated purposes), consent (obtaining permission before collecting or using data), and the right of individuals to access, correct, or delete their personal data. Organizations handling personal data are increasingly required to implement security safeguards and be transparent about their data practices.
